title: refactor(app-shell): move ObjectView's view-options family into objectViewOptions.ts (slice 2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9VtKf3F9dzJPJM4RRtABaEc)_

Part of #25992 (slice 2 of the move-only split; slice 1 landed as #26152, and the card stays open for any later slice).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What moved

Base `d00215f6` (slice 1 merged). This slice moves the view-options family and the view-patch dispatcher, verbatim, out of `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` into a new sibling module `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewOptions.ts`:

- `timelineViewOptions`, `calendarViewOptions`, `ganttViewOptions`, `galleryViewOptions`, `kanbanViewOptions` (with the shared docblocks above them)
- `storedLegacyOptions`
- `isSameOptionsValue` (was file-local; it gains the `export` keyword because the component still calls it, and `ObjectView.tsx` does NOT re-export it, so no new name is published from there)
- `dispatchViewPatches`

`ObjectView.tsx` imports all eight back and re-exports the seven names it exported before, from the same path. The package entry is untouched. `detectStatusField` is imported by the new module instead of `ObjectView.tsx` (its only reader moved). `ObjectView.tsx` goes from 3689 to 3254 lines.

Move-only proof: the multiset of non-blank lines of the base `ObjectView.tsx` equals new `ObjectView.tsx` plus `objectViewOptions.ts`, after normalising the one added `export` keyword. Nothing is missing; the only added lines are the new module's header comment, the import and re-export blocks, and their one-line comment.

## Test edits (all forced by the move, as the claim allows)

1. `ObjectView.calendarBinding-7029.test.tsx`, the "no invented calendar field name survives in the source" scan
2. `ObjectView.galleryBinding-7547.test.tsx`, the "no invented gallery cover name survives in the source" scan
3. `ObjectView.ganttBinding-7070.test.tsx`, the "no invented gantt date name survives in the source" scan
4. `ObjectView.titleFieldConvergence.test.tsx`, the "the seven seams share ONE expression shape" scan

Each `readFileSync` of `ObjectView.tsx` now reads `ObjectView.tsx` and `objectViewOptions.ts` and joins them. Reading both, not only the new module, keeps every scan over exactly the lines it read before: the titleFieldConvergence count ("exactly six") spans four seams that moved and two (map, tree) that stay in the component, and the calendar/gantt/gallery tripwires keep covering the component's own relay. No assertion changed.

5. `writeRefusalCensus-11583.test.ts`: the `LEDGER` row for `dispatchViewPatches` (callee `updateView`, kind `relays`) is keyed `file: 'objectViewOptions.ts'` instead of `'ObjectView.tsx'`. The `handleSetDefaultView` row that calls it stays on `ObjectView.tsx`.

No other test file changed.

## Verification

See the os-dev-report comment on the card for the full readings. In short: every test file under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/` plus the 7 source-reading tests outside it passed (1160 files); app-shell `type-check`; eslint on the 7 touched files with 0 errors; the 35 derived dispatch gates; a Console build after merging the latest main.

## Acceptance notes

- Some moved prose still says "below" or "above" about the relay in `ObjectView.tsx` (for example the `storedLegacyOptions` docblock's "The relay below"). It is kept verbatim because the slice is move-only; the relay is now in the sibling file.
- `ObjectView.unboundAdapterCall.test.ts` still scans only `ObjectView.tsx` for a detached adapter write. `dispatchViewPatches` itself calls through the object, and the census row above still pins it.

Changeset: `.changeset/25992-objectview-options-split.md` (patch, `@object-ui/app-shell`).
